front_blocks.md: In what format is presentation content provided in the exam?

back_blocks.md: The content is provided in **rich text format (.rtf)**.

cards.front_md: In what format is presentation content provided in the exam?
cards.back_md: The content is provided in **rich text format (.rtf)**.

front_blocks.md: How is rich text content imported into a presentation?

back_blocks.md: Using the **'New Slide'** button on the **Home tab** and selecting **'Slides from Outline'**.

cards.front_md: How is rich text content imported into a presentation?
cards.back_md: Using the **'New Slide'** button on the **Home tab** and selecting **'Slides from Outline'**.

front_blocks.md: Define **master slide**.

back_blocks.md: A master slide allows you to **control the design and layout of an entire presentation from one place**.

cards.front_md: Define **master slide**.
cards.back_md: A master slide allows you to **control the design and layout of an entire presentation from one place**.

front_blocks.md: Name four things a master slide controls.

back_blocks.md: A master slide controls the **colours**, the **fonts**, the **headers and footers**, and the **positioning of objects**.

cards.front_md: Name four things a master slide controls.
cards.back_md: A master slide controls the **colours**, the **fonts**, the **headers and footers**, and the **positioning of objects**.

front_blocks.md: How do you add automatic slide numbering?

back_blocks.md: **Select the master slide**, **insert a text box**, then from the **Insert tab** select **'Slide Number'** and close the master slide.

cards.front_md: How do you add automatic slide numbering?
cards.back_md: **Select the master slide**, **insert a text box**, then from the **Insert tab** select **'Slide Number'** and close the master slide.

front_blocks.md: How do you add an object to every slide in a presentation?

back_blocks.md: **Select the master slide**, choose an object from the **Insert tab**, **position it on the slide**, then close the master slide.

cards.front_md: How do you add an object to every slide in a presentation?
cards.back_md: **Select the master slide**, choose an object from the **Insert tab**, **position it on the slide**, then close the master slide.

front_blocks.md: How do you format a master slide?

back_blocks.md: **Select the master slide**, make the desired **font and paragraph** changes, then **close the master slide**.

cards.front_md: How do you format a master slide?
cards.back_md: **Select the master slide**, make the desired **font and paragraph** changes, then **close the master slide**.

front_blocks.md: What does editing a presentation depend on?

back_blocks.md: Editing depends on the **audience and purpose** of the presentation.

cards.front_md: What does editing a presentation depend on?
cards.back_md: Editing depends on the **audience and purpose** of the presentation.

front_blocks.md: Which tab is used to insert, move and delete slides?

back_blocks.md: The **Home tab**, in the **'Slides'** section.

cards.front_md: Which tab is used to insert, move and delete slides?
cards.back_md: The **Home tab**, in the **'Slides'** section.

front_blocks.md: Name three objects that can be inserted into a presentation.

back_blocks.md: Using the **Insert tab** you can add **images**, **videos** and **charts**.

cards.front_md: Name three objects that can be inserted into a presentation.
cards.back_md: Using the **Insert tab** you can add **images**, **videos** and **charts**.

front_blocks.md: Define **presenter notes**.

back_blocks.md: Presenter notes are **prompts for the presenter** when delivering a presentation, and usually contain the **key talking points**.

cards.front_md: Define **presenter notes**.
cards.back_md: Presenter notes are **prompts for the presenter** when delivering a presentation, and usually contain the **key talking points**.

front_blocks.md: Where are presenter notes turned on?

back_blocks.md: On the **View tab**, in the **'Show'** section, select **Notes**.

cards.front_md: Where are presenter notes turned on?
cards.back_md: On the **View tab**, in the **'Show'** section, select **Notes**.

front_blocks.md: What can a hyperlink be added to in a presentation?

back_blocks.md: A hyperlink can be added to **text or objects**, such as images and videos, using **Insert** then **Link**.

cards.front_md: What can a hyperlink be added to in a presentation?

front_blocks.md: Define **action button**.

back_blocks.md: An action button is a **clickable object that enhances the interactivity** of a presentation.

cards.front_md: Define **action button**.
cards.back_md: An action button is a **clickable object that enhances the interactivity** of a presentation.

front_blocks.md: Name three common actions of an action button.

back_blocks.md: Common actions are **navigation**, **media playback**, **running programs** and **opening links**.

cards.front_md: Name three common actions of an action button.
cards.back_md: Common actions are **navigation**, **media playback**, **running programs** and **opening links**.

front_blocks.md: Define **screen tip**.

back_blocks.md: A screen tip is **short explanatory text that appears when you hover over an element** on a slide, providing additional details.

cards.front_md: Define **screen tip**.

front_blocks.md: What is alternative text used for?

back_blocks.md: Alt text **describes an image**. It is used for **accessibility with screen readers** and to help users **understand the content of an image**.

cards.front_md: What is alternative text used for?
cards.back_md: Alt text **describes an image**. It is used for **accessibility with screen readers** and to help users **understand the content of an image**.

front_blocks.md: What is the difference between a transition and an animation?

back_blocks.md: A **transition** is used when **moving between slides**, while an **animation** adds **movement or emphasis to elements on a slide**.

cards.front_md: What is the difference between a transition and an animation?
cards.back_md: A **transition** is used when **moving between slides**, while an **animation** adds **movement or emphasis to elements on a slide**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
An animation is the effect used when moving from one slide to the next.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
That is a **transition**. An **animation** adds movement or emphasis to elements **on a slide**.

cards.front_md:

cards.back_md:
**False.**

front_blocks.md: How do you hide a slide without deleting it?

cards.front_md: How do you hide a slide without deleting it?

back_blocks.md: The layouts are **full page slides**, **presenter notes** and **handouts**.
